reasons: The file contains only a description, so there is nothing to test or judge.

terms.meaning: a set of programs that check other code still works

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Test folder description
sections.what: Describes the test folder. It contains no code.
sections.why: Lets Python treat the tests folder as a package.

summary: Marks the tests folder as a Python package and describes it; it runs no code.
purpose: Gives the test folder a name and description.
why: Python needs a file like this to treat the folder as a package.
how: Python reads the file when a test file is imported from this folder.
debug: If test discovery fails, check that this file exists.
